explanation: The deterministic pipeline reports verdict uncertain with zero supported physical failure events for this window. Gripper joint data cannot determine holding (E0), and a measured opening at 41.1s (E3) alone is not a drop. Window tracks show motion but without release criteria do not constitute a failure event (E4). End-of-episode plate detections are region=unknown with no interior calibration, so final placement inside the rack is not established (E1, E2).

factual_claims.text: Pipeline found no supported physical failure events in this window (n_physical_events=0, verdict uncertain).
Gripper reading cannot show whether an object is held; a thin plate does not change the closed reading.
Measured gripper opening at 41.1s (frame 1233, measured=15.598) is observed but opening alone is not a drop and holding is not detectable from this joint.
Not every expected object has an established final position: green plate 0/? established inside.
End-of-episode plate observations at frame 2061 are region=unknown with confidences ~0.91-0.94; inside requires interior calibration and footprint-only yields outside or unknown.
Window track motion summary shows displacement for green plate:1 and :2 but displacement alone without rest->move->rest + release criteria does not constitute a supported physical failure event.

hypotheses.text: The robot may have been attempting to place a plate in the rack around 41.1s when the gripper was measured open, but this cannot be confirmed as a successful placement or a drop from joint data alone.
End-state plates appearing in the rack in the final image could represent successful placements, but pipeline marks them as unknown due to missing interior calibration, so success cannot be verified.

visual_interpretations.text: F0 (40.1s) appears to show the red arm holding a green plate above the dish rack, with two green plates on the table.
F1 (41.1s) appears to show the gripper lowered into the rack with the plate vertically oriented, coinciding with measured opening.
F2 (44.1s) appears to show the arm reaching toward a green plate on the table, suggesting a subsequent pick attempt.
F3 (68.7s) appears to show multiple green plates standing in the dish rack, but pipeline does not verify they are inside due to lack of interior calibration.

limitations: Gripper joint cannot distinguish empty closed vs holding thin plate (E0), so grasp/hold state is unverifiable.
Inside vs outside determination requires interior calibration; footprint-only yields unknown (E1, E2).
Object ids from window SAM tracks vs end-of-episode SAM are not matched, preventing cross-gap identity claims.
No physical_events were emitted; motion/displacement alone is insufficient for failure event support (E4).
